subtitle: Lesson 28 · MongoDB Distribution & Scaling

titlePlain: Pick the lever that matches the

steps.label: Sharding
steps.sub: scales writes & data volume, most complex

code:
1. Diagnose: reads, writes, or storage?
   (mongostat, mongotop, Atlas metrics)

2. CPU/RAM-bound single node?
     -> vertical scaling first

3. Read query volume is the bottleneck?
     -> add replicas (secondaryPreferred)

4. Write throughput / data volume
   outgrew one primary?
     -> shard (only then)
caption: Reaching for sharding first is the common, costly mistake.
